label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/insecure-randomness): alert-TP — the insecure randomness is used to generate 'rememberMeKey' which is stored as a session attribute and added to an HTTP cookie. This is used for session management and thus constitutes security-sensitive material. Alert 2 (java/xss): alert-TP — the resolved sink value is 'bar' which is derived from user input 'param' in the 'doSomething' method, and this value is directly concatenated into the HTML response output. Case TP: at least one alert-TP.

evidence.note: rememberMeKey generated using java.util.Random.nextInt() - insecure randomness
User-controlled 'bar' value concatenated into HTML response, leading to XSS
